title: Updates discovery and staging smoke test
summary: Verify issue #58 on a private Atlas installation without activating a release or restarting OpenCode.
intro: Use a reviewed Atlas build that includes issue #58, an existing shared-access account, and a newer public Atlas GitHub Release. Run host commands on the Atlas host. Do not expose tokens or key contents.
conventions: Replace ATLAS_PRIVATE_URL with the private Tailscale Serve URL. Record exact visible messages and command output when a check fails.

items.title: This smoke test stages only
items.instruction: The expected endpoint is a complete inactive release tree. Do not change /opt/atlas/current, restart Atlas manually, or use any unpublished activation procedure.
items.expectedResult: The operator understands that issue #58 has no Install, Retry, automatic activation, or OpenCode lifecycle action.

items.title: Record the selected release and OpenCode process
items.instruction: Run these read-only commands before bootstrap and keep their output for the final comparison.
items.expectedResult: The first command prints the currently selected immutable Atlas release directory; the second prints the current OpenCode process ID.
items.failureGuidance: Stop if the selected release is missing or OpenCode is unexpectedly inactive; resolve the host baseline before testing bootstrap.

items.title: Run the documented bootstrap command
items.instruction: Run the bootstrap from the selected reviewed release.
items.warning: This privileged command installs or updates systemd units, stable updater/credential service files, and restricted keys. It may briefly restart Atlas only when credential runtime ownership must be transferred; it must not restart OpenCode.
items.expectedResult: The command exits 0 and prints that the Atlas credential supplier and updater bootstrap completed and OpenCode was not restarted.
items.failureGuidance: Do not proceed. Inspect systemctl status and the Atlas journal namespace without printing /etc/atlas key or credential contents. Correct the bootstrap failure, then rerun the command.

items.title: Verify independent service continuity
items.instruction: Confirm both surviving services are active and compare the OpenCode process ID with the value recorded before bootstrap.

codeBlocks.content:
systemctl is-active atlas-credentials.service atlas-updater.service
systemctl show --property=MainPID --value opencode.service

items.expectedResult: Both is-active lines are active, and the OpenCode process ID is unchanged.
items.failureGuidance: Stop. A changed OpenCode process ID or inactive surviving service violates the lifecycle boundary; preserve journal evidence and do not test staging.

items.title: Open Updates with existing Atlas access
items.instruction: In a desktop browser, sign in through the normal shared-access flow and open ATLAS_PRIVATE_URL/updates from the global Updates link.
items.expectedResult: The responsive Atlas shell shows one Updates heading, installed and available release identities, Approval required, discovery time/result, staging status/result, host runtime requirements, and the statement that OpenCode is not checked for release eligibility.
items.failureGuidance: Capture the full screen and exact visible text. If authentication or the whole app is unavailable, treat this as an environment failure rather than a staging result.

items.title: Check and stage the public release
items.instruction: Record the current selected release with the command below. In the browser, activate Check now once, then return to or remain on Updates while the status refreshes.
items.expectedResult: Checking is distinct from failure; an eligible release progresses through request/download/verification/extraction and finishes as Staged with a durable latest result. Repeated page refreshes do not start conflicting copies.
items.failureGuidance: Keep the page open long enough to receive a terminal status. Record whether the failure is release discovery, updater availability, download, checksum, extraction, metadata identity, or a host runtime limitation; do not activate or delete any tree.

items.title: Confirm staging did not activate or pause work
items.instruction: Run the selected-release command again and inspect one pre-existing Active Session through Atlas.
items.expectedResult: The selected release path exactly matches the value recorded before Check now. The existing Session retains its state/identity, and the page offers no Install, Retry, or automatic-activation control.
items.failureGuidance: Stop and preserve the selected path, Updates page, Session page, and Atlas journal evidence if selection or Session admission changed.

items.title: Check keyboard and phone layout
items.instruction: Use only the keyboard to reach the global Updates link and Check now. Then inspect the same page at 320 CSS pixels wide and at a desktop width.
items.expectedResult: Focus remains visible; links and Check now are reachable; identities and status wrap without page-level horizontal scrolling; Inbox, Updates, and sign-out controls remain accessible on the phone layout.
items.failureGuidance: Capture phone and desktop screens plus the focused element and viewport width before reporting the layout failure.

items.title: Verify candidate limitations when present
items.instruction: If the published candidate declares code-only rollback incompatible or requires a host Bun, Git, or gh version not available on this host, inspect the corresponding Updates presentation.
items.expectedResult: Rollback incompatibility shows Manual maintenance required with the published instructions. Runtime mismatch names the required and reported versions and does not claim the updater will upgrade host tools.
items.failureGuidance: Do not try to bypass the limitation. Record the candidate tag, displayed requirements, and exact instructions for the release maintainer.
